$Comment: Marn's first job for a new mill owner: run the Sawmill, mill lumber on it, bring some back.
The three steps teach the loop in the order it happens.
run_cycles counts real Sawmill cycles (WORK_STATION, Target = the station id as its asset
spells it, never the block id). mill_lumber counts what the mill hands over (STATION_OUTPUT
with Qualifier 'Sawmill', so only this station's output counts): its Target 'Wood_' on PREFIX
catches every species and every cut the mill can make, and the step carries its own TextKey
because the kind's default line names one item and this step means 'any lumber'. The
qualifier suffix is added to the line automatically, so the key's text never says where. Both
sit on Order 1; bring_planks is Order 2, a hand-in to Marn only (TurnInNpcId 'giver').
Rewards sit in Claim: the copper hatchet is the first rung of the tool ladder (a better hatchet
is more planks per cycle and more of everything else the mill pays), and the XP split favours
the skill the mill trains. Retune the three Amounts freely; the item on the first reward is
Name: First_Cut
